semantic_fragments.content: Clause 13.2: For ME equipment and ME systems intended to actively keep alive or resuscitate a patient, reducing the auditory alarm signal volume below audible levels was not possible, except when the alarm system was connected to a distributed alarm system that included generation of auditory alarm signals per IEC 60601-1-8:2006 and IEC 60601-1-8:2006/AMD1:2012. Result: See attached IEC 60601-1-8 Report. Verdict: N/E.

Clause 8.4 supplementary information: Not life supporting ME equipment or ME system. Verdict N/A for Additional requirements for interruption of power supply / supply mains to ME Equipment and ME Systems.

Shock test results (Clause 10.1.2a): Peak acceleration 150 m/s2 (15 g), duration 11 ms, pulse shape half-sine, 3 shocks per direction per axis (18 total). All six directions (+X, -X, +Y, -Y, +Z, -Z) maintained basic safety and essential performance. Note: This represents Class 7M1 as described in IEC TR 60721-4-7:2001.

Broad-band random vibration test results (Clause 10.1.2b): Acceleration amplitudes across three frequency bands (10-100 Hz: 1.0 (m/s2)2/Hz; 100-200 Hz: -3 dB/octave; 200-2000 Hz: 0.5 (m/s2)2/Hz), 30 min per perpendicular axis. All axes (X, Y, Z) maintained basic safety and essential performance. Verdict: P.
